evidence.code_available: no code link anywhere in the paper
evidence.hyperparameters_complete: Sec. 4.1, p. 4: 5000 clauses, T=5000, s=1.5, 150 epochs; clause scope, number of TA states, implementation and the amplitude scaling of the Boolean image are not given
evidence.interpretability_evidence: Sec. 4.3-4.4, Figs. 5-6: per-pixel include maps of all positive/negative-polarity clauses per class, and local-log-density heatmaps (Eq. 6) compared with VGG16 Grad-CAM

task_detail.class_balance: imbalanced, majority 86.4% (Non-PVC 38161, PVCR 3965, PVCL 2054 of 44180 beats)
task_detail.discretized_from: AAMI 5 beat classes (N, S, V, F, Q): N/S/F/Q merged into Non-PVC, V split into PVCR (right-ventricle origin) and PVCL (left-ventricle origin)

preprocessing.params: lead II, 360 Hz; 11 recordings excluded for failing quality criteria, 36 recordings / subjects kept (paper says 48 recordings, 47 subjects)
'Bior 2.6' wavelet, 9-level decomposition; d1, d2 and a9 coefficients set to 0, then reconstruction (removes power-line interference and baseline wander)
beat segmentation at the MIT-BIH R-peak annotations: 320 samples (144 before, 176 after), QRS apex aligned to the same position

booleanization.description: Each segmented beat is drawn as a Boolean 100 (amplitude) x 320 (time) image and flattened row by row into a 1 x 32000 vector; how amplitudes are scaled onto the 100 rows is not stated.

evidence.booleanization: Sec. 2.2, p. 3 (last paragraph); Sec. 3, p. 3 (32,000 inputs, 64,000 literals)
evidence.split: Sec. 4.1, p. 3 and Sec. 4.2, p. 4: 36 subjects divided randomly into 9 folds of 4 subjects (patient-wise), 9-fold cross-validation; Fig. 4

evidence.model: Sec. 4.1, pp. 3-4: 1-D CNN of Baloglu et al. 2019, Adam, categorical cross-entropy, lr 1e-3, decay 1e-4, batch 64, 100 epochs, PyTorch
Sec. 4.1, p. 4: VGG16 (2-D CNN) on the beat images; training settings only stated for 'the CNN model'

notes: Single results table (Table 1); precision/recall are per class, accuracy is overall 3-class. How the 9 folds are aggregated (mean over folds vs pooled predictions) is not stated, nor whether the 150-epoch TM number is the final epoch; no validation set or hyper-parameter search is described. Clause scope is ambiguous: Sec. 3 says q x n clauses with n per class, but '5000 clauses' is not qualified. Modality recorded as time_series (ECG beats), although the TM input is a rendered 2-D Boolean image (VGG16 also uses images). The paper's counts are internally inconsistent: 48 recordings minus 11 excluded would be 37, but 36 recordings/subjects are used. Class imbalance (86% Non-PVC) is not addressed by any balancing step. Figures 5-6 (interpretability maps, heatmaps) carry no numbers.
